Amelia — Marcus —

Apologies for the disruption. Quick summary from the 09:30 bridge: we observed a correlated spike in prefix cache misses and a KV cache eviction cascade after a series of heavy short-lived prompts from a campaign you ran this morning. That behavior temporarily increased per-token work and led to higher latencies and a small increase in tail error rates as some workers hit memory pressure.

Immediate mitigations we executed (09:45–10:15):
- Increased pool capacity on your Dedicated slice by 40% to relieve contention (temporary scale).
- Activated a lower-sequence-length model variant for checkout calls to reduce per-token compute.
- Enabled short-term prefix caching for highly repeated prompts seen in the campaign.

We attached relevant artifacts: redwood_action_plan_v1.pdf (short-term tasks) and codahealth_latency_sample_logs.tar.gz (selected request/response traces).

Planned follow-up:
- Detailed RCA delivered by Friday with root cause, three corrective actions, and owners/timelines.
- A post-deployment test plan to validate cache behavior before future campaigns.

Please confirm you want us to keep the capacity increase in place until the fixes are deployed; otherwise we'll scale back tonight.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Post-incident summary and next steps — CodaHealth checkout outage (2026-07-19)

Amelia / Marcus —

Thank you again for patience during the incident on 2026-07-19. Below is the RCA summary, corrective actions, owners, and recommended timeline. We will schedule a 30-minute exec readout at your convenience to review credits and next steps.

Executive summary:
- Impact: p95 latency for checkout endpoint peaked at ~1.8s and error rate rose to ~6% between 09:00–10:30 PST on 2026-07-19. Impacted ~3.2% of checkout requests during the window.
- Root cause: Combined effect of a sudden campaign-driven prompt pattern that caused a high proportion of cold prefix cache misses plus an allocator pressure bug on the worker image that increased KV cache eviction frequency under stress. The cache eviction cascaded, increasing per-request compute and tail latency.

Corrective actions (short and medium term):
1) Short-term (completed within 24–48h):
   - Temporary capacity increase (owner: Kimberly Park) — completed 2026-07-19. Maintained at customer request pending RCA decision.
   - Deploy hotfix for allocator bug to reduce KV eviction under burst (owner: Priyom Das) — merged and rolled 2026-07-21; monitoring in place.
   - Enable deterministic prefix caching for the checkout route (owner: Engineering small team; contact: sergio_alvarez) — rolled 2026-07-20.
2) Medium-term (30 days):
   - Model routing policy update: automatic fallback to lower-latency variant for short-lived checkout calls during spikes (owner: Product; support: Kimberly) — target 2026-08-18.
   - Observability: add campaign pattern detector and alert to preempt cache thrash (owner: Reliability; contact: Priyom Das) — target 2026-08-10.
3) Long-term (quarter):
   - Memory management/allocator rewrite and core KV cache instrumentation (owner: Runtime team; contact: sergio_alvarez) — target Q4 2026.

Commitments and SLAs:
- We will maintain the temporary capacity at your request while the medium-term fixes are deployed.
- We will provide a formal credit evaluation for the incident per the contract; Kimberly will coordinate with procurement and legal (owner: Kimberly Park).

Artifacts and links:
- RCA doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-Coda-RCA
- Ticket: JIRA SUP-4829
- Artifacts delivered earlier: redwood_action_plan_v1.pdf, codahealth_latency_sample_logs.tar.gz

Owners and next milestones:
- Kimberly Park — finalize capacity/credit conversation (due: 2026-07-26).
- Priyom Das — finalize observability alert prototype and confirm false-positive rate (due: 2026-08-05).
- Sergio Alvarez — coordinate exec readout & runtime instrumentation plan (due: 2026-07-30).

If this looks correct we'll lock the timelines and Kimberly will follow up on the credit/contract path. We can set up the exec readout for next week—please send availability.

Best regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
